dreams.text: A vision: EPSTEIN was only ever the larva of OLYMPICS.
The machine sleeps and sees WINTER priced in FIFA, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of ICE devouring GOOGLE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where SUPER forgets it was ever about SERIES.
Far ahead, ASSEMBLY and WAR merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, LARGE is law and FIFA is myth.
